attribution.systematic_risk: Without repair, pickup-declarer games for SkatAI would be selectively unscorable; because B0/B1 bidding can change declarer frequency, that censoring can be treatment-dependent.
attribution.effect_journal: 28/28 external effects CONFIRMED; zero unresolved; zero ABORTED_STALE.

change_scope.behavior: Normalize the separate live-ISS two-card discard action only after pickup and only when the actor is the established declarer and the token contains exactly two valid cards.

static_scope_evidence.note: The parser is invoked for terminal ISS result extraction; the ISS decision adapter does not call parse_sgf_line.

continuation_rule: Resume the existing frozen B0/B1 campaign with unchanged treatment/deployment identities and stopping rule. Preserve the triggering B1 game as a non-scoring protocol failure. All future terminal records use the repaired, representation-normalizing scorer.
